name: AF with Stroke Within 1 Year (New Dataset)
description: AF patients from new dataset who experienced stroke within 1 year of AF diagnosis. This is a stroke-enriched cohort for treatment effectiveness studies.

metadata.use_case: Treatment effectiveness in high-risk patients with early strokes
metadata.notes: Highly selected cohort - only patients with stroke_1Y=1 (stroke within 1 year). Will have uniform stroke rates and limited discrimination.
